name: lee-internal-comps
description: Internal (Dealius) and external lease & sale comps, demographic reports, and owner-of-record lookup for authorized Lee & Associates Raleigh brokers. Twelve skills: internal-comps (Dealius mirror, Excel + Lee-branded PDF), external-comps (weekly external snapshot via typed MCP tools, Excel + Markdown table), demographic-summary (1/3/5 mi single-page Lee infographic for any NC address, JSON + Lee-branded PDF with 1-hour signed link), demographic-detail (multi-page Demographic and Income Profile with inline SVG charts, race/income breakdowns, 2020/2025/2030 projections via gi_permit_adjusted with Census BPS add-back, Family HHs + Owner HUs trend bars, four Esri-analog indices, and Lee-branded PDF), business-key-facts (BAO-style Business Key Facts 3-page landscape PDF for any NC address: key statistics, households table, site map with 1/3/5 mile rings, education attainment + workforce charts, population/housing growth), and owner-lookup (owner of record + mailing address + assessor facts for any property in Wake, Durham, New Hanover, or Lee NC, sub-second from a bulk-staged D1 owner graph of ~2M parcels/owners/links), and daily-debrief (Will-only interview-style classification of yesterday's broker requests: walks through each plugin session AND each off-plugin ask one-by-one, capturing the off-plugin category (plugin_broke / known_gap / new_opportunity) so the rollup drives the roadmap conversation), and tenants-in-market (scheduled Cowork ingest of Triangle Pairlist tenant-requirement emails: screens each as a tenant requirement vs a listing and writes every screened email to a shared, queryable tenant_requirements store via the lee_tenant_requirement_write MCP tool; analyst/automation skill, not broker-invoked), and owner-mailing-list (deduplicated owner + mailing-address CSV from public county parcel data for an area + criteria request: drives Claude-for-Chrome against a county's ArcGIS parcel service to find matching parcels and return owner names + mailing addresses, deduped and filtered to private owners — 19 NC counties; requires the Claude in Chrome extension), and internal-and-external-comps (the default all-comps skill: an unqualified comps request pulls BOTH internal Dealius and external CoStar in parallel and returns one combined chat table, Excel, and a Lee-branded unified PDF tagged by source -- sale and lease), and add-comps (normalize a contributed comp set a broker pastes, forwards, or uploads -- a forwarded email with several brokerage comp tables, an xlsx/csv, a pasted table, or a screenshot -- into canonical records tagged by source/provenance and ingest them as a third source via the lee_comps_add_write MCP tool, queryable across all three sources via pull_unified_comps; lease and sale; analyst/operator skill). Plus process-mapping: a guided interview that maps any team member's repeatable process into a clean process-map document for GI (CRE = firm context, role-agnostic).
